comment: This was not a terrible game, just a disappointing one for me. I could see some appeal because the combat stayed engaging for a long time and the moment-to-moment gameplay felt sharp, but the game still felt too uneven overall. It might work for other people, but it was not for me.

It is a decent game, even if it never fully clicked for me. It feels like a small project with real personality, and it has a clear identity instead of feeling generic, but the experience still loses momentum in places. I would call it a cautious recommendation at best.

After a few sessions, this one won me over. The combat stayed engaging for a long time, and the strategic layer kept me paying attention. It is worth trying if this genre is already in your wheelhouse.

I can see what the game is aiming for, but the execution feels uneven. I could see some appeal because the combat stayed engaging for a long time and survival pressure made the sessions memorable, but the game still felt too uneven overall. I would only recommend it to someone who is already very into this niche.

I can see why this game has a strong audience. It has a clear identity instead of feeling generic, and it does a good job selling the simulation idea. I would recommend it, especially if the tags already sound appealing to you.
